output_list.criticism: The migrate function in the BlocklancerToken contract relies on the block number (block.number) as a condition to conduct critical operations, such as transferring Ether. This could potentially lead to unexpected behavior or security vulnerabilities if the block number is manipulated.

The transfer function in the BlocklancerToken contract also relies on the block number (block.timestamp) as a condition to transfer tokens. This could potentially lead to unexpected behavior or security vulnerabilities if the block number is manipulated.

The fallback function in the BlocklancerToken contract also relies on the block number (block.timestamp) as a condition to transfer tokens. This could potentially lead to unexpected behavior or security vulnerabilities if the block number is manipulated.

The refund function in the BlocklancerToken contract relies on the block number (block.timestamp) as a condition to refund Ether. This could potentially lead to unexpected behavior or security vulnerabilities if the block number is manipulated.
